note: EXPANSION 19, BUILD 19 (complete release scope, owner directive 2026-10-23 docs/directives/2026-10-23_x19_complete_release_scope.md): NPC judgment, personality, relationships, family name, gossip, memory, lies, family stories, stubbornness and the family-first hierarchy, all ON and influencing decisions. Owner approvals of 2026-10-23 (docs/design/X19_RELEASE_DECISIONS.md sections A-D and the directives it cites) set the numbers below; values still marked PROVISIONAL are agent values the owner may tune. Earlier text: NPC judgment and decision weighting. The owner answered SJD-Q01, Q02, Q06, Q07, Q08, Q10, Q11 and Q14 on 2026-10-21 (docs/directives/2026-10-21_expansion19_sjd_final_decisions.md): their RULES are implemented here; their NUMBERS (rates, weights, thresholds) are still agent proposals unless the owner set them. The owner answered Q03, Q04, Q05, Q09, Q12 and Q13 and X19-ASSAULT, X19-GUARD, X19-HARMED, X19-CRT12, X19-DECAY on 2026-10-23 (docs/directives/2026-10-23_owner_answers_*.md); Q05 'Not at all' removed the prior bias; Q09 'near-best' is selection margin with runner_up_permille 150 (AGENT-PROPOSED number); assault is permanent (X19-ASSAULT). X19-DECAY (half-life) is decided in the directive but its rate here is untouched until the calendar is explained. docs/expansion19/DESIGN.md reconciles every setting with the decisions. Points are integer milli-points (1000 = 1 point) and fractions integer permille (1000 = 1.0), so replay and saves are exact. enabled is true for Build 19 (tests turn it off with JudgmentLive.test_disabled to compare with Build 18).
_events_note: The event catalog (spec s.3; SJD-Q12, provisional: what is worth scoring). Every event is a fact (Q01). polarity GOOD or BAD gives the baseline the observer's interpretation is relative to; NEUTRAL facts (meetings, marriages) are recorded, remembered and told like any other and score only by an optional per-observer rule "personal" {severity, beneficiary, victim, kin, friend: P permille}; none is set, so they mean nothing morally to anyone (Q01: no automatic moral significance). severity: milli-points (spec seed values: minor help 0.5, theft 1, rescue 2, killing 3). permanent: a murder (Q02, Q11) or an assault (X19-ASSAULT, 2026-10-23: 'Permanent', like murder): memories of it never fade and judgments from it never decay. min_value: a theft or trade below this many coins of goods is not scored. (SJD-Q05 'Not at all', 2026-10-23: no event is read through prior opinion; the ambiguous flag and the prior bias are removed.)
_news_note: GP-DIALOGUE A5 (owner directive 2026-10-24, open items 01 and 02; REPAIR_AUDIT D2; agent decision): village news as facts, so it travels by knowledge (who took part, who saw it, who was told), never by a global record: a household's purchase or lease of land, its fence, relief from the manor or the chapel, a villager without the tool of their trade, a death (its kind: slain, starvation, old age, other; never who did it: a killing is its own fact). Family 'news', NEUTRAL, no personal rule: known and told, never judged (no ledger, trust, personality or bond moves). Held apart from the moral memories (memory.news_capacity) and told apart from the moral stories (gossip.news_per_meeting, gossip.news_daily_budget), with ids of their own (JudgmentStore.NEWS_BASE), so the moral gossip is as it was. Numbers are agent proposals.
_interpret_note: Signed interpretation P in permille (spec s.4; Q08: personal morality, relationships, loyalties and who was affected; law is separate and not modelled here). The victim of a BAD event or the beneficiary of a GOOD one reads it at affected; the actor's partner in a BAD deed at accomplice; others by their tie to the affected party (kin, friend, else bystander), reversed to rival when they judge the affected party at or below rival_net_at. Loyalty to the actor (kin_of_actor, friend_of_actor) softens condemnation. morality_spread_permille: each person's own moral sensitivity per family of deeds, fixed by the seed, 1000 +/- this (proposal; never applied to the one affected). No prior-opinion bias exists (SJD-Q05 'Not at all'). Every number here is an agent proposal.
_belief_note: Provenance and confidence (Q06). Witnesses and participants are firsthand: their confidence is witnessed or participant, no storyteller to weigh. A told story's confidence: the teller's confidence x hop_factor x credibility; credibility is the listener's trust in the immediate teller: credibility_stranger for no tie, rising to 1000 with the existing relationship number (Relations regard 0..100), moved by the listener's judgment of the teller (credibility_permille_per_point a point of NET), within credibility_min..1000. Over several people the product along the chain is the transmission history. confidence_policy (multiplier: impact = S x P x C). Numbers are agent proposals.
_trust_note: X19-REGARD (owner 2026-10-23, 'Separate them': liking and trust tracked apart). Liking stays Relations' regard (it sets how close two people are, so which gossip passes). Trust is the listener's reliance on another person, milli-points 0..100000, kept in the judgment store (trust_of) and saved with it; it sets credibility (belief.credibility_*). With no record it is a first impression, regard x seed_from_regard_permille (so a stranger starts at 0 and a well-liked newcomer a little above). What moves it: an event type's own 'trust' milli-points (a fair deal raises, a cheat or a false charge lowers) times the observer's confidence and the actor's share, once a belief is first formed; a story a teller told that is later borne out by what the listener learns first-hand (rumour_confirmed) or shown wrong, with another actor (rumour_false). Kept promises and contracts would use the same per-event 'trust' field once the game publishes them as events. No decay (proposal). ALL NUMBERS ARE AGENT PROPOSALS awaiting owner review.
_memory_note: Personal memory (Q11). Ordinary memories: at most capacity a person; salience starts at severity x confidence (a NEUTRAL fact at neutral_salience) and fades salience_fade_permille a day; under forget_below it is forgotten. Permanent memories (never fade, never pushed out, not counted in capacity, their facts never retire): murder always (the type's permanent), anything at least permanent_severity, and, for the one it happened to (victim or beneficiary), anything at least permanent_personal_severity (proposal: being assaulted or rescued yourself). Forgetting keeps the judgment (retract_on_forget false; the judgment fades by decay instead, Q02). horizon_days: how long an ordinary event can still be told or corrected (an engineering bound on facts and dedup keys; permanent records are exempt). dawn_slices: the daily update is spread over this many hours (same result however sliced).
_decay_note: Q02, X19-DECAY (owner 2026-10-23, 'Approve all'): ordinary GOOD and BAD judgments fade with a half-life of 2 game years = 16 game days (a game year is 8 game days): ordinary_permille_per_day 42 (0.958 a day, 0.958^16 = 0.503). Murder and assault never fade (the permanent part of a ledger). Memory salience (memory.salience_fade_permille) is a separate thing: what a person can still recall and retell. Demonstration: game/tests/judgment_decay_demo.gd and docs/expansion19/DESIGN.md. 0 turns decay off.

decay._status: APPROVED 2026-10-23 (X19-DECAY): ordinary GOOD and BAD judgments halve in 2 game years (16 game days of 8 per year): 42 permille a day, 0.958^16 = 0.50; murder and assault never fade

_gossip_note: Word of mouth (Q07): only when two people actually spend time together (Relations' shared hours); no hop limit, no confidence floor: a story travels as far as real meetings carry it. Exchange limits per conversation: per_meeting memories each way, daily_budget tellings a teller a day. A teller only shares with someone whose judgment of them is above share_net_at (proposal). Each person judges each event once; a belief is replaced only by a more confident one. misattribute_permille: the chance (seeded hash) a rumour names the wrong actor (0: off). pump_per_tick: queued meetings told each World tick (same result whatever the pace). timing: "scheduled" (the owner's answer to X19-Q-TIMING, 2026-10-23: gossip spreads organically by contact and closeness: each meeting is told at its own minute of the hour, no catch-up) or "hour" (the reference mode: meetings count as told at the hour's start; kept for the identity tests and measurements, not used live). closeness_floor_permille: the chance a story passes in a meeting between strangers (regard 0), rising to certain at regard 100 (AGENT-PROPOSED number, awaiting owner review; 1000 turns the weighting off). Credibility (belief.credibility_*) already scales how far the listener believes by the same regard.
_personality_note: SJD-Q03 (owner 2026-10-23, 'Own tolerance each': personality-based thresholds seeded at birth; some forgive quickly, some hold grudges) and SJD-Q13 ('Born with + shaped by life': weights seeded from personality at birth, then nudged by what happens to them; deterministic). The game has no personality system, so each person's temperament is a hash of the world seed and their id (nothing stored for it, identical after save/load). TOLERANCE scales the two NET thresholds (interpret.rival_net_at: when a bystander turns rival; gossip.share_net_at: whom a teller will still talk to): 1000 +/- tolerance_spread_permille; above 1000 a person puts up with more before souring, below 1000 holds a grudge sooner. WEIGHTS: decision.trait_spread_permille moves each decision weight of each person by up to that much either way (per factor). LIFE EVENTS (firsthand only: the person's own experience as victim or beneficiary, once per event): being the victim of a BAD deed lowers tolerance by tolerance_per_point x severity points; being the beneficiary of a GOOD deed raises the weight on disposition (what they think of others, hence trust in a helper) by weight_per_point x severity points; each shift is bounded to +/- max_shift_permille and saved in the judgment section ('life'). ALL NUMBERS ARE AGENT PROPOSALS awaiting owner review; 0 spread and 0 steps turn the whole thing off.

personality._status: APPROVED 2026-10-23 (X19-PERSONALITY): temperaments differ by up to 30%; being wronged lowers tolerance 4% a severity point (replaced by the traits drift while traits are active, RECON-01), being helped raises the weight of opinion 3% a point, at most 25% either way

_traits_note: X19-FOUND-PERS, X19-PERS-FORMULA and X19-TRAIT-DIST (owner approved 2026-10-23: docs/design/X19_RELEASE_DECISIONS.md section B, 'Approve (Recommended)'); judgment_personality.gd. All durations are game days (a game year is 8). Starting traits: stubbornness_share_permille 300 (about 30% of villagers can be stubborn, a fixed per-person hash), starting between start_min and start_max permille (20% to 60%, a hash of the person id); the other 70% have 0. Tolerance: each person differs from the norm by up to 30% (personality.tolerance_spread_permille). Drift: each firsthand provocation pulls tolerance down and stubbornness up, each help the other way, by rate_permille_per_point 20 (2%) per severity point. frequency: each earlier experience of the same kind within window_days 8 (a year) adds gain_permille 250 (a quarter) to the pull, at most cap 4 (so at most double). duration: ongoing hardship adds 100 permille (10%) a day it lasts, at most cap_days 5 (50%). soft_limit: the further a trait is from where the person started, the less a pull works, falling evenly to floor_permille 200 (a fifth of its force) at scale_permille 400 (40% away), never to 0. recovery: a push back toward the origin works at the full rate (1000); past the origin it keeps going at half rate (growth_past_origin_permille 500). learning (practical wisdom): rate 20 permille (2%) per point of cost; each repeat of the same kind of mistake within repeat_window_days 8 adds accel 500 (half again), at most repeat_cap 3; transfer_permille 250 (a quarter of what is learnt carries to every situation); cap_permille 500 (wisdom tops out at 50%); wisdom reduces how much stubbornness weighs in a choice by that share. emotion: anger 100 permille (10%) per severity point, fading evenly over anger_days 1 (one game day, 'several weeks'); a reminder (meeting the offender, hearing the story retold) brings back reminder_permille 250 (a quarter) of the first peak, never above reminder_cap_permille 500 (half) of it; at anger_at or above override_threshold_permille 500 the stubborn override holds for the anger's remaining time (override_days 1). stubborn (what stubbornness does in a decision, JudgmentWeighting): resent_penalty and switch_penalty (milli-points at full weight) are taken off every option that means dealing with someone the chooser resents or giving up the choice made last time in that decision, scaled stubbornness x (1 - wisdom); override_penalty is decisive. The three penalty sizes are PROVISIONAL agent values (the owner's packet defines the form, not the size).

traits._status: APPROVED 2026-10-23 (formula and numbers); the three stubborn.* penalty sizes are PROVISIONAL agent values

_bonds_note: X19-FOUND-BONDS and X19-FOUND-FAMREP (owner directive 2026-10-23, sections 4 and 5; judgment_bonds.gd). A pair's history (the highest regard ever reached, a former-friend flag that never stacks, betrayals never erased) and resentment (a value apart from regard, trust and NET). familiarity_permille 100 and family_permille 50 are the owner's ~10% and ~5% calibration targets and combined_permille 120 the owner's ~12% when both qualify: deterministic multipliers on a regard gain applied by Relations BEFORE its daily caps (no cap raised, no days-known gate shortened). Active negative standing (suspends familiarity): resentment above zero in either direction, or either one's NET of the other below negative_net_below. A serious grievance (severity at least serious_severity) cannot soften before serious_floor_days (0: Life.year_days(), one in-game year); softening is only through personality growth and soften_milli_per_day is 0 (inert): no decay curve is invented. reach is the unresolved X19-SPILL-REACH (none: no family reputation at all; line = parents and children, family = plus siblings and partner are fixtures for tests); Build 19: reach is "extended" (relationship distance, ring_spill_permille 300/150/75/37 for rings 1 parents-children-siblings-spouse, 2 grandparents-grandchildren-aunts-uncles-nieces-nephews-in-laws, 3 first cousins, 4 second cousins; ring_inherit_permille 1000/500/250/125 for a good name at the same falling weights; all PROVISIONAL); transmission (X19-REP-TRANSMIT) is the observer's own remembered judgments of those relatives, fading with X19-DECAY, each personal dealing replacing a tenth; the inherited impression colours the disposition in decisions (JudgmentStore.colour) up to inherit_cap_permille of the strongest personal judgment and never alone causes a refusal (JudgmentWeighting). It is kept apart from the direct, relationship-weighted reactions to witnessed deeds (interpret). friend_level 0: Relations' befriend_at.

bonds._status: familiarity/family/combined are owner targets; reach is the owner's wider answer (parents, children, siblings, spouse; grandparents, grandchildren, aunts, uncles, nieces, nephews, in-laws; first and second cousins) with weights falling by relationship distance; the ring weights are PROVISIONAL agent starting values (owner clarification 2026-10-23: do not treat as owner-selected); transmission is the observer's own remembered judgments (no new store); a personal dealing replaces a tenth (override 100) and the inherited impression is capped at a quarter of the strongest personal judgment (inherit_cap_permille 250) and can never alone cause a refusal

_lies_note: X19-MISINFO (owner approved 2026-10-23, section D): only someone who holds serious resentment toward the subject (resentment at least min_resentment milli-points: an assault or two thefts; PROVISIONAL size) or a rivalry (their NET of the subject at or below the rival line, interpret.rival_net_at scaled by their tolerance) may invent a story about them: at most one per liar per game year (gap_days 0 means Life.year_days()), in chance_permille 50 (5%) of the meetings where they gossip about that person, decided by a seeded hash of the liar, the listener, the subject, the meeting minute and the day (never World.rng). An invented story accuses the subject of one of `types`. It is a fact tagged as a lie (the fact is what was said; no such deed happened). It is proven false when a guard hears it (the village reports show no such crime) or a firsthand witness does (kin of the accused); then only those who learn that correct their judgment, and the liar loses trust.rumour_false (15 points) of trust with each of them. The reference gossip.timing 'hour' never invents (identity measurements).

lies._status: chance 5% and one a year APPROVED; min_resentment, types, and who counts as a firsthand witness (guards, kin of the accused) are agent values

_family_story_note: X19-STORY-LIFE (owner approved 2026-10-23, section D): parents pass permanent deeds (a killing, an assault, a betrayal by a friend: such memories never fade) and serious good deeds (good events of at least good_severity milli-points: a rescue) to their children as family stories when the child comes of age and they are at home together, each passing at the gossip rate (gossip.closeness_floor_permille, rising with their regard); ordinary deeds fade with X19-DECAY and are not passed on. A new adult waits at most expire_days for a parent to be home with them.

family_story._status: rule APPROVED; good_severity and expire_days are agent values

_self_defence_note: X19-EVENT-Q (owner approved 2026-10-23, section A): (1) a guard killing an attacker is not judged a killing; (2) first meetings are not recorded as facts (no feed publishes `meeting`); (3) a late repayment is a fair deal with half the trust gain (the fact is tagged late); (4) self-defence: a blow answered within the same fight is not judged as an attack, nor a killing of the one who struck first. A fight ends when no blow has fallen for fight_minutes (agent value).
_history_note: GM-01 historical memory (Build 19 recovery R4; World Design Rule 009; owner directive 2026-10-19 docs/directives/2026-10-19_memory_refuges_politics.md Part I, the 30 planks). The significance rule: a deed of a kind in types becomes a historical record (kept after its fact retires, saved, known by those of the two households at the time and handed down by parents to children at coming of age) when it is worth at least min_value and at least significant_share_permille of what it went toward (a house's cost still to pay when it was given). max_generations: how many tellings from the deed it is still handed down (4: to the great-great-grandchildren). Knowledge only: no judgment, trust or decision reads it. The owner's documents give no number: all PROVISIONAL agent values (2026-10-27).
_aspiration_note: EXPANSION 20 R5, WDR-011-C (World Design Rule 011 as amended to six domains; owner's final decisions 2026-10-27, docs/directives/2026-10-27_final_aspirations_decisions.md; design docs/expansion20/R5_ASPIRATIONS_DESIGN.md; judgment_aspiration.gd). OFF (enabled false) until validation and owner review; decision.integration.job_choice is its own flag and needs this on. Six domains: food, wealth, property, profession, family, standing. Priority permille = temperament (1000 +/- priority_spread, a seeded hash) + age (young_until: family and profession +young_step; old_from: profession -old_profession_step, food and standing +old_step) + saved shifts (+/- max_shift). Satisfaction 0..100000 each morning; pressure = effective priority x (100000 - satisfaction) / 1000; the highest leads; all below content_below: content (neutral everywhere). Survival level (0..1000, the highest of three parts: severe hunger, from hunger_from down to the OWNER survival floor 25, decision.family.survival_floor_hunger (hunger_from is well below the ordinary appetite, balance eat_below 55, which most villagers pass every morning before breakfast); injury, health between injury_from and decision.family.danger.hp_floor_permille; danger, the household's own real situation and never hearsay: danger_step for each BAD violence fact (assault, killing) within danger_days whose victim is the villager or a member of their household, theft_step for each theft or pocket picked from them; a lie is no harm) raises food by boost_food and makes the others yield by yield_base (never below yield_floor), softened by stubbornness x hold_share; it falls at most recover_per_day a day. Success (a band of band_edges crossed upward) shifts that domain by -success_step; a setback (downward, or the loss of a partner, child or parent): a holder of stubbornness (OWNER share about 30%, traits.stubbornness_share_permille) +setback_step x stubbornness, the others -setback_step x (1 + general wisdom); giveup_after setbacks within window_days reverse even a stubborn one. Marriage: property +marriage_step. factor_weights: the aspiration factor's weight in the yes-or-forgo profiles (value 50 points + fit x min(lead pressure, factor_cap); forgo raised by the same weight x 50 points, so neutral changes nothing); fit: per profile and leading domain, -1, 0, +1 or a condition. court: weights of the courting factors when on (attraction and disposition replace the profile's), scaled_by the chooser's effective priority of a domain. job: settings of the job_choice profile's factors. EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A PROVISIONAL AGENT VALUE (FAD Q5), recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md, except the two owner values read from where they live.

aspiration._status: PROVISIONAL agent values, 2026-10-27 (R5); off until validation and owner review (FAD); owner values (hunger floor 25, stubbornness share 300) are read from decision.family and traits

_decision_note: Decision weighting (spec s.7; Q14: judgment is one weighted influence inside the existing decision points; SJD-Q03 own tolerance and Q13 weights: see personality and trait_spread_permille; Q04 ambivalence is stored with weight 0; Q09 answered: selection margin, the best usually, a seeded close second runner_up_permille of the time (AGENT-PROPOSED 150)). The live decision code supplies the feasible candidates and factor values (0..100000: milli-points on the spec's 0..100 scale); disposition = 50 points + NET, clamped to 0..100. utility = sum(weight permille x factor) / 1000. live_order: the live code's own preference (first 100 points, 10 less for each after), so with every judgment neutral the live choice stands. forgo: the utility of doing without. integration: which existing decision points consult judgment when a store is attached (all of them off with judgment off). Every weight is an agent proposal.

job_choice._status: R5 (FAD Q2) PROVISIONAL agent weights; used only with decision.integration.job_choice and aspiration.enabled on

decision._family_note: FAMILY-01 (owner directive 2026-10-23 family sacrifice and responsibility; owner answers: father and mother alike, built with Expansion 19 behind this switch, everyone in the head's care, rare exceptions only). The order children, spouse, parents, self is a RULE in judgment_family.gd, never weighed; these profiles weigh only whether the person gives up the meal, who pays, and work before leisure, with the family factors recorded in the trace. Personality moves where a choice flips through the ordinary per-person weight spread, never the order. Numbers are AGENT PROPOSALS awaiting owner review: survival_floor_hunger: hunger (0..100, full 100) at or below which a deferring adult eats whatever the family needs (enough left to keep working and protecting; the game eats below balance eat_below 55 and starves at 0); coin_floor: coins the paying parent keeps; extreme_share_permille: of the holders of stubbornness (about 30% of villagers), the share with the extreme temperament that sometimes puts self first (150 of 1000 is about 4.5% of villagers); self_first_hunger: such a person eats once hunger is at or below this (above the floor); self_first_coin_floor: the coins such a head keeps back; work_coins_below: under this many coins a parent whose dependants are hungry and unfed seeks the manor's paid work before leisure; trace_cap: decisions kept in JudgmentStore.family_trace.

family._status: numbers accepted by the owner 2026-10-23 (docs/directives/2026-10-23_owner_answers_family_danger.md, 'Accept'): survival floor hunger 25, head coin floor 3, seek paid work under 20 coins, self-first exceptions 15% of the stubborn group; the danger behaviour ('Shield and fetch help') is owner-approved, its radii (danger.radius, reach, cornered_radius in tiles) are agent values

decision._report_note: SJD-F crime hook (Build 19 recovery R2, B19_RECOVERY_MATRIX row SJD-F; owner rule 2026-10-26 docs/directives/2026-10-26_npc_judgment_refusal_correction.md: judgment influences, never dictates). A villager who knows of a crime (World.report_crime: saw it, was its victim, or sighted a wanted player) weighs telling a guard against keeping quiet through JudgmentWeighting.choose, profile report. Who may report and how a report travels (PAR-05: guards, report.range, report.hours) are unchanged; only the choice between the two feasible options is weighed. Option report: live_order 100 points (the Build 18 rule always reports) plus harm (harm_victim for the victim, harm_attack for a witness of an attack, harm_theft of a theft). Option silent: the witness's own opinion of the offender (disposition, with the family name's colour), kinship with the offender (100 points when kin) and fear (the violence the witness holds against the offender: the permanent BAD part of their ledger of them x fear_permille_per_point / 1000, at most 100 points). Personality enters as in every profile: each person's weights spread by trait_spread_permille, the life shift on disposition, and stubbornness (keeping quiet for someone resented is penalised). No reputation cutoff, no guaranteed outcome: two witnesses of the same crime may decide differently. A family member fetching help against a danger (judgment_family.gd) is a rule, not weighed. All numbers PROVISIONAL agent values (2026-10-27); integration.report is OFF until R6 measures it.

report._status: PROVISIONAL agent values, 2026-10-27 (R2); off by default (integration.report false)
